description_en: Redeploys a specified resource immediately or at a scheduled time
description_zh: 用于立即或预约重新部署指定资源的事件
kebab_example: aliyun ens event-redeploy-instance --event-id e-d71ff150945b9c02eb6ebc0016328468 --resource-id i-55qi8m11rr53c4i964md8a00l --ops-type immediate --region cn-hangzhou
name: EventRedeployInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the system event
parameters.help_zh:
系统事件ID。

仅 Inquiring 状态的事件可被操作；建议通过 DescribeHistoryEvents 按 EventStatus=Inquiring 过滤可操作事件。对非 Inquiring 状态的事件调用会返回 500004
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en:
The O&M task type. Valid values:

immediate: Executes the task immediately.
scheduled: Executes the task at a scheduled time
parameters.help_zh:
运维任务类型，取值范围：

immediate：立即执行。
scheduled：预约执行
parameters.name: ops_type

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] The scheduled execution time. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required when OpsType is set to scheduled. Use PlanUtcTime instead
parameters.help_zh: 预约执行时间，时间戳，单位毫秒。 当OpsType=scheduled时，此字段为必输。待废弃字段，优先使用PlanUtcTime
parameters.name: plan_time

parameters.help_en: The scheduled execution time in UTC. The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. This parameter is required when OpsType is set to scheduled. If both PlanUtcTime and PlanTime are specified, PlanUtcTime takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
预约执行的UTC时间，格式YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。
OpsType=scheduled 时，此字段为必输。
此字段与PlanTime同时存在时，优先取PlanUtcTime
parameters.name: plan_utc_time
